messages:
Maya (Product PM): Quick alignment ask — LargeRetailCo pushed for a private deployment with strict SLAs. Target ship date 2026-04-15. Must-haves: VPC + KMS, 180d audit logs, p95 latency <50ms for chat gen. We need to decide scope (full caching + quantization now vs. minimal ship + perf roadmap). Who's blocked and what are realistic sequencing windows?

Jorge (Runtime): Noted. To hit <50ms p95 on their workload we need the new attention kernel backport + perf testing. Rough plan: kernel dev (1 week), perf bench + tuning (2 weeks), integration with KV caching (1 week). So ~4 weeks dev+test.

Priya (Infra): VPC + private control plane work required. We'll need network review + subnet provisioning + IAM/KMS integration. I can start subnet templates this week but need net team approval and a ticket for HSM/KMS onboarding. ETA ~2 weeks for baseline infra, plus 1 week to validate with runtime.

Sam (Security): Security gating: threat model update and SOC review, then pen test scheduling. If we accept compensating controls (limited customer access + monitoring) I can sign an initial approval sooner, but full sign-off w/ pen test is ~4 weeks. We should define minimal acceptable mitigations before GA.

Alex (Backend Eng): Agree with Jorge. Also flag: our current autoscaler doesn't account for KV-cache priming — could spike costs during ramp. We should either add priming throttles or roll out with scaled-down caching. Work estimate for throttle: 1 sprint.

Lin (Prod Ops): From rollout perspective we can do staged canary in two phases: 1) private customer sandbox (1-2 nodes) 2) private prod pool. Prefer leaving telemetry/advanced observability for phase 2 to reduce scope.

Maya (Product PM): Proposed sequencing: Phase A (ship core private API + KMS + basic caching, limited telemetry) by 2026-04-15; Phase B (full caching, quantization profiles, advanced telemetry) by 2026-05-20. Does that map to your timelines?

Jorge (Runtime): Phase A looks OK if we scope caching to prefix cache only (no global priming) and skip quantization until Phase B. That saves ~2 weeks.

Priya (Infra): Phase A infra timeline works if network review and KMS ticket are prioritized today. I'll raise INFRA-298 and ping net-team.

Sam (Security): Phase A acceptance conditions: documented threat model, sensitive data flow diagram, and compensating monitoring. I'll draft acceptance checklist and attach SEC-145. Pen test schedule for Phase B.

Alex (Backend Eng): I'll open ENG-4120 for the throttle work and a small runtime toggle for cache mode. If toggles exist we can ship Phase A and flip on enhanced caching in Phase B.

Maya (Product PM): Great — next steps: 1) Priya create INFRA-298 (VPC/KMS) today 2) Jorge open ENG-4121 (kernel backport) + ENG-4120 (throttle) 3) Sam publish SEC checklist (SEC-145) 4) Lin book canary window Apr16-Apr22 and notify SRE. I'll update roadmap and tell LargeRetailCo we expect Phase A by 2026-04-15, Phase B by 2026-05-20.

Priya (Infra): INFRA-298 created: https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/INFRA-298. Pinging net-team.

Jorge (Runtime): ENG-4121 + ENG-4120 opened. Links: https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/ENG-4121, https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/ENG-4120. I'll start the kernel PR today.

Sam (Security): SEC-145 checklist draft posted: https://confluence.redwood.internal/sec/SEC-145. Tagging @Lin for rollout constraints.

Lin (Prod Ops): Canary window booked and added an ops runbook. Notifying oncall and SRE channel.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: 2026-04-16T02:00Z to 2026-04-22T02:00Z.

Maya (Product PM): Thanks everyone. Two open risks: (1) pen test slipping Phase A — Sam, can we get a contingency if it slips? (2) LargeRetailCo requires 180d audit retention — Priya please confirm KMS/HSM SLA.

Sam (Security): Contingency: temporary restricted access + continuous monitoring until pen test completes. I'll add this to SEC-145. :+1: 

Priya (Infra): Confirm KMS for 180d logs fine, HSM onboarding may add time for keys-in-HSM. I'll note for INFRA-298.

Alex (Backend Eng): I'll add feature flags so we can rollback caching quickly if anything spikes.

Maya (Product PM): Perfect. I'll circulate this thread as the alignment note and book a quick sync tomorrow 30m to close blockers. :raised_hands:
